acceptedAnswer.text: SGPA (Semester Grade Point Average) is the average of grade points earned in all courses taken during a specific semester. It's calculated using the formula: SGPA = (Σ Ci × Pi) / (Σ Ci) where Ci is credits and Pi is grade points.

CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) is the average of SGPA across all semesters. It's calculated using: CGPA = (Σ SGPAi × Ni) / (Σ Ni) where SGPAi is the SGPA of the i-th semester and Ni is the number of credits.

mainEntity.name: How do I convert CGPA to percentage?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can convert CGPA to percentage by multiplying the CGPA by 10. For example, if your CGPA is 8.5, your percentage would be 8.5 × 10 = 85%.

mainEntity.name: What grading system does this calculator use?

acceptedAnswer.text: This calculator uses the standard 10-point grading scale: S (91-100%), A+ (86-90%), A (75-85%), B (66-74%), C (55-65%), D (50-54%), and F (0-49%).
